question:

HKOE , KNOE , ? , QTOE , TWOE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaedcbd547a4e9adcc9df497fdea2f5b00376e03a3505f7b4d50c5b4bf90c96b.png]
